 Early Voting by Congressional District and Locality: Nov. 2026
 Check our updated early voting visual for daily counts of early-in person and mail ballots cast so far. Choose a Congressional District to drill down and see the numbers by locality within each district.
 For more data, including comparisons to past years, and whole locality results, see VPAP's early voting dashboard .
 Notes: Includes early in-person votes and returned mail ballots for the November 2026 election. Locality and district numbers may not add up exactly to higher level totals, due to missing district or locality information for some records.
 Source: Virginia Department of Elections, early voting file.
